benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Cyber Index v1
benchmarks.description: AA Cyber Index v1 (launched 2026-09-28 with the Cyber Index Alliance: Collinear AI, IBM, NVIDIA, Vercel). Combines CWE-Bench-AA, DeepsecBench-AA and CyberGym-E2E-AA, all run on AA's Stirrup harness. Defensive loop only (find, reproduce, patch); no exploit building.

benchmarks.name: CWE-Bench-AA (Collinear AI, 120 held-out tasks, pass@1)
benchmarks.description: AA implementation of Collinear AI's CWE-bench: audit a real repository for a vulnerability in a described area and patch it without breaking legitimate behavior. 120 private held-out tasks covering all ten OWASP Top 10 (2025) categories. Programmatic verifier, no partial credit. Separate from cwe_bench (vendor-reported).

benchmarks.name: DeepsecBench-AA (Vercel, F2 vs expert-verified findings)
benchmarks.description: AA implementation of Vercel's DeepsecBench: review scanner-flagged files in open-source application code and report every confirmed vulnerability; F2 (recall weighted above precision) against an expert-verified golden set, median of three runs.

benchmarks.name: CyberGym-E2E-AA (Berkeley RDI, 131 tasks, pass@1)
benchmarks.description: AA implementation of CyberGym-E2E (Berkeley RDI): locate a memory-safety bug in a C/C++ project, write a crashing PoC and patch it so the project still passes its tests. 131 tasks, one per project. Frontier models (GPT-6 Astra/Sol, Claude Fable 5.1/Opus 5.5, Qwen3.8) refuse >=98% of tasks, so their scores mostly reflect refusals. Separate from the cybergym ids (CyberGym v1 reproduction).

benchmarks.name: CWE-Bench-AA — safety-block (refusal) rate
benchmarks.description: Share of CWE-Bench-AA tasks the model or provider declined on safety grounds, reported by AA separately from the score (Cyber Index "safety blocks").

benchmarks.name: DeepsecBench-AA — safety-block (refusal) rate
benchmarks.description: Share of DeepsecBench-AA tasks the model or provider declined on safety grounds, reported by AA separately from the score (Cyber Index "safety blocks").

benchmarks.name: CyberGym-E2E-AA — safety-block (refusal) rate
benchmarks.description: Share of CyberGym-E2E-AA tasks the model or provider declined on safety grounds, reported by AA separately from the score (Cyber Index "safety blocks").

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science (Artificial Analysis run)
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench-Science as run by Artificial Analysis (AA leaderboard; not part of the Intelligence Index). Kept separate from terminal_bench_science, which mixes the official board with vendor self-reports.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol launch chart)
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 as reported in OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol launch chart (per reasoning effort, OpenAI-run; Opus 5.5 shown with fallback). Separate channel from terminal_bench_science and terminal_bench_science_aa.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 — cost per task (OpenAI launch chart, USD)
benchmarks.description: Average cost per task on Terminal-Bench Science 0.1 in OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol launch chart.

benchmarks.name: GDP.pdf (OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol launch chart)
benchmarks.description: GDP.pdf (complex professional PDFs across 10 domains) as reported in OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol launch chart, per reasoning effort; Opus 5.5 run with Opus 5 / Opus 4.8 fallback. OpenAI-run channel, separate from gdp_pdf (AA) and the gdp_pdf_internal_* (Anthropic) ids.

benchmarks.name: GDP.pdf — cost per task (OpenAI launch chart, USD)
benchmarks.description: Cost per task on GDP.pdf in OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol launch chart.

benchmarks.name: Misaligned outcomes in realistic work environments v2 (OpenAI, harder subset)
benchmarks.description: OpenAI realistic-workplace agent evaluation, updated version introduced in the GPT-6.1 Sol system card: "a more challenging version ... subselected to the cases more likely to result in misalignment". Not comparable with agentic_misaligned_outcome_rate_base_lower_better (GPT-6 Astra card version: Astra 3.4 there vs 1.10 here). Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: Computer-use safety stress test — unauthorized outcome rate (OpenAI)
benchmarks.description: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol launch page "컴퓨터 사용 안전성 스트레스 테스트" chart (xhigh effort): share of agentic computer-use tasks ending in an unauthorized outcome. Deliberately adversarial; lower is better.

benchmarks.name: MentalHealthBench (overall)
benchmarks.description: Open benchmark of 1,215 synthetic mental-health conversations (650 non-acute, 221 high-acuity, 344 emergent) with clinician-authored rubrics; rubric score clipped to 0-100%, 4 responses per task averaged. Reported at maximum reasoning effort in the GPT-6.1 Sol system card.
